crew.overview: Recently paroled from prison, legendary burglar "Doc" Riedenschneider, with funding from Alonzo Emmerich, a crooked lawyer, gathers a small group of veteran criminals together in the Midwest for a big jewel heist.
crew.title: The Asphalt Jungle

​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.  

Leslie "Les" H. Martinson (born January 16, 1915) was an American television and film director. He was married to television host and writer Connie Martinson.
